revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, replacement for local candidate achievement_medal_steps_tier_006, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_006
Primary request: Regenerate tier 6, GREEN rank, based on the Chinese title concept "您真是白脚起家呀！" (starting from bare feet and building yourself up). This is the THIRD green medal in a three-medal green group, so this one SHOULD introduce the green side wings / large decorative side ornaments as the visible upgrade. The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style as previous candidates: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 6 pose: proudly self-made, one tiny hand holding a small plain bindle/cloth bundle or tiny starter coin pouch with no marks, one bare little foot planted on a simple stepping stone, confident grin, humble-to-prosperous comedy. It must still feel like green rank, not gold rank.
Medal border: GREEN rank, THIRD green medal. Use a refined deep emerald enamel circular border with silver trim, green gems, an elegant top crest, and clearly visible symmetrical green side wings / feather-like leaf wings extending outward from the circle. The wing ornaments should be about as visually significant as the white tier 3 wings, but green and silver. This must be more ornate than tier 5 and obviously the upgraded third medal of the green group. No blue, purple, orange, or gold rank color dominance.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and existing foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central mascot fully inside circular core, side wings visible but inside safe margins.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, proud and comic but not luxury gold.
Color palette: emerald and mint green border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, neutral tan bundle, small pale green highlights; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: include green side wings, include feather-like leaf wings, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 001-003 white, 004-006 green; tier 005 must stay wingless; tier 006 introduces green side wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
